records.jp: はあ～……この映画、良かったあ。<CR>あと４回ぐらい観たい……
records.en_original: That movie sure was something... I could watch it like four more times.
records.en_auxiliary: That movie sure was something... I could watch it like four more times.
records.en: Ahh... That movie was so good.<CR>I want to watch it about four more times...

records.jp: 時空と世界を超えたラブロマンス……<CR>愛央の目にも涙……
records.en_original: A romance that transcended both time and space...You were quite misty-eyed, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: A romance that transcended both time and space...You were quite misty-eyed, Ao.
records.en: A love story transcending time and worlds...<CR>Even Ao was moved to tears...

records.jp: あはは、途中で泣いたのバレてたかー
records.en_original: Ahaha, caught me crying, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, caught me crying, huh?
records.en: Ahaha, caught me crying, huh?

records.jp: うん、ずっと隣で見てた
records.en_original: Yes. I was watching the whole time.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I was watching the whole time.
records.en: Yes. Kirara watched you beside her the entire time.

records.jp: えっ！？
records.en_original: ...Ack!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Ack!
records.en: ...Ack!

records.jp: いや、私じゃなくて映画、観なよ！
records.en_original: Watch the movie, not me!
records.en_auxiliary: Watch the movie, not me!
records.en: Watch the movie, not me!

records.jp: 映画も観てたし、愛央も見てた
records.en_original: I was watching both.
records.en_auxiliary: I was watching both.
records.en: Kirara watched the movie and Ao too.

records.jp: どっちも見逃せない……
records.en_original: I didn't want to miss a second of either...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't want to miss a second of either...
records.en: Kirara could not miss either one...

records.jp: ……泣いてるのは見逃してよ
records.en_original: I think you can afford to miss me crying...
records.en_auxiliary: I think you can afford to miss me crying...
records.en: I think you can afford to miss me crying...

records.jp: なんで！？
records.en_original: Why?!
records.en_auxiliary: Why?!
records.en: Why?!

records.jp: んー……良いと思ったから？
records.en_original: Hm... I thought it was nice.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... I thought it was nice.
records.en: Hmm... Because Kirara thought it was nice?

records.jp: 良いって、私が泣いてるのが？
records.en_original: It was nice? You mean me crying?
records.en_auxiliary: It was nice? You mean me crying?
records.en: It was nice? You mean me crying?

records.jp: うん。素直に感動して、泣いてる愛央は<CR>綺麗だと思った
records.en_original: Yeah. You wear your emotions on your sleeve. I thought it was beautiful.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. You wear your emotions on your sleeve. I thought it was beautiful.
records.en: Yes. Ao was honestly moved and crying.<CR>Kirara thought you looked beautiful.

records.jp: き、綺麗って……
records.en_original: B-beautiful...?
records.en_auxiliary: B-beautiful...?
records.en: B-beautiful...?

records.jp: あ……今、照れた？
records.en_original: I think someone's blushing.
records.en_auxiliary: I think someone's blushing.
records.en: Ah... Did you just get embarrassed?

records.jp: いや、むしろ恥ずかしい！
records.en_original: Yeah, 'cause I'm embarrassed!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, 'cause I'm embarrassed!
records.en: No, I'm embarrassed!

records.jp: 恥ずかしがる愛央……ちょっとレア。<CR>近くで見てもいい？
records.en_original: This is a rare sight indeed. May I take a closer look?
records.en_auxiliary: This is a rare sight indeed. May I take a closer look?
records.en: An embarrassed Ao... This is a little rare.<CR>May Kirara look from up close?

records.jp: ダメ
records.en_original: No way!
records.en_auxiliary: No way!
records.en: No way!

records.jp: どうして？
records.en_original: Why?
records.en_auxiliary: Why?
records.en: Why?

records.jp: どうしても！
records.en_original: Because!
records.en_auxiliary: Because!
records.en: Because!

records.jp: 仕方ない。<CR>今日のところは見逃してやろう
records.en_original: Oh, well. I'll let you go...for now.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, well. I'll let you go...for now.
records.en: It cannot be helped.<CR>Kirara will let you go for today.

records.jp: （なんで、そんな悪役っぽいセリフ……）
records.en_original: (Why is she speaking like a villain?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Why is she speaking like a villain?)
records.en: (Why is she speaking like a villain?)

records.jp: もうすでに近いから！
records.en_original: You're close enough already!
records.en_auxiliary: You're close enough already!
records.en: You're already close enough!

records.jp: いや、まだ、もう少し……
records.en_original: Just a bit closer...
records.en_auxiliary: Just a bit closer...
records.en: Just a bit closer...

records.jp: くっつく、くっつく！<CR>オデコがくっついちゃうから！
records.en_original: Any closer and our faces are gonna touch!
records.en_auxiliary: Any closer and our faces are gonna touch!
records.en: We'll touch,<CR>we'll touch! Our foreheads are going to touch!

records.jp: ……しまった。<CR>近すぎてよく見えない
records.en_original: Drat. Now I'm too close to see anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Drat. Now I'm too close to see anything.
records.en: ...Drat.<CR>Kirara is too close to see clearly.

records.jp: もお！　ほら、離れて離れて！
records.en_original: Jeez! You're in my personal space!
records.en_auxiliary: Jeez! You're in my personal space!
records.en: Jeez! Come on, move away!

records.jp: てか、私の顔なんか見てどうすんの？<CR>そんなに面白い？
records.en_original: Why are you so interested in my face anyways?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you so interested in my face anyways?
records.en: What are you going to do by staring at my face?<CR>Is it that interesting?

records.jp: 愛央の顔、きららの心のメモリーに保存して、<CR>必要な時にロードする
records.en_original: I'd like to save it on my hard drive so I can view it when I need to.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to save it on my hard drive so I can view it when I need to.
records.en: Kirara will save Ao's face in the memory of her heart<CR>and load it whenever necessary.

records.jp: 必要な時って？
records.en_original: When you need to? When would that be?
records.en_auxiliary: When you need to? When would that be?
records.en: When you need to? When would that be?

records.jp: ん～。<CR>愛央に会いたくなった時とか
records.en_original: Mmm... Like when I miss you and want to see you.
records.en_auxiliary: Mmm... Like when I miss you and want to see you.
records.en: Hmm.<CR>When Kirara misses Ao and wants to see her.

records.jp: それなら……
records.en_original: Well in that case...
records.en_auxiliary: Well in that case...
records.en: Well in that case...

records.jp: 会いたいなら、直接会いに来なよ。<CR>いつでも、会えるんだしさ
records.en_original: If you miss me you should just come see me. We can see each other whenever we want.
records.en_auxiliary: If you miss me you should just come see me. We can see each other whenever we want.
records.en: If you want to see me, come and see me directly.<CR>We can meet whenever we want.

records.jp: メモリーの中だけなんて、つまんなくない？
records.en_original: Isn't seeing the real me more interesting?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't seeing the real me more interesting?
records.en: Wouldn't it be boring if I existed only in your memory?

records.jp: ……たしかに
records.en_original: You have a point.
records.en_auxiliary: You have a point.
records.en: You have a point.

records.jp: じゃあ、またきららと遊んでくれる？
records.en_original: Then you'll spend time with me again?
records.en_auxiliary: Then you'll spend time with me again?
records.en: Then will you play with Kirara again?

records.jp: うん。もちろん！
records.en_original: Of course I will!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course I will!
records.en: Of course I will!

records.jp: 私も、きららをメモリーに保存したい。<CR>近くで見てもいい？
records.en_original: Then, I should save your face too! Mind if I get a closer look?
records.en_auxiliary: Then, I should save your face too! Mind if I get a closer look?
records.en: I want to save Kirara in my memory too.<CR>Can I look at you up close?

records.jp: うん、どうぞ
records.en_original: Be my guest.
records.en_auxiliary: Be my guest.
records.en: Be my guest.

records.jp: じー………
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Staaare...

records.jp: ……てか。<CR>スマホで写真とればよくない？
records.en_original: ...Wait, why don't I just take a picture with my phone?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Wait, why don't I just take a picture with my phone?
records.en: ...Wait.<CR>Wouldn't it be easier to take a picture with my phone?

records.jp: 文明の力……！
records.en_original: The power of technology...!
records.en_auxiliary: The power of technology...!
records.en: The power of technology...!

records.jp: んじゃ、撮るよー！<CR>はい、チーズ！
records.en_original: Okay, here we go! Say cheese!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, here we go! Say cheese!
records.en: Then I'm taking it!<CR>Say cheese!

records.jp: おお、良い感じに撮れてるじゃん
records.en_original: Hey, this turned out great!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, this turned out great!
records.en: Hey, this turned out great!

records.jp: 後で、きららにも送るよ
records.en_original: I'll send it to you later, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll send it to you later, Kirara.
records.en: I'll send it to you later, Kirara.

records.jp: うん……楽しみ
records.en_original: Okay... I look forward to it.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay... I look forward to it.
records.en: Okay... I look forward to it.
